text:
Marta G.: hey folks — quick one. i'm planning a temporary base change: Dublin -> SF starting May 1, but i'll be in Dublin Wed-Fri and SF Mon-Tue for about 12 weeks. can i keep EU benefits and still get the monthly wfh stipend? also worried about state tax nexus and whether payroll flips.

Sam (People Ops): hey @Marta G.! short answer: maybe. long answer: homebase typically dictates payroll and benefits. for splits under 90 days we often keep original homebase, but we need tax ops to confirm no nexus in CA (or the specific county). please file the Homebase Change + Hybrid Exception with dates and travel pattern.

Marta G.: cool. will do. i expect to start May 1 and finish Jul 24 (12 weeks). stipend should kick in from May 1 if possible and be prorated.

Nina (Payroll): heads-up from payroll:
- Payroll cutovers can take 6-8 weeks to complete (entity registration, tax forms).
- If you spend >60 cumulative days in the US in a tax year we may need to do US withholding or register the company in the state.
- Action item: include passport copy and SSN/ITIN (if you have) on the form.

Jorge (Benefits): regarding coverage:
- EU medical typically doesn't cover routine care in the US. if you remain on Dublin payroll but travel to SF, you may rely on out-of-network benefits or file for reimbursement.
- We can add the Global Medical Rider for up to 90 days. beyond that, you'll need local enrollment.
- Don't cancel EU benefits until payroll confirms homebase status.

Raj (Finance): on stipend and expenses:
- Stipend proration formula we use: monthly_stipend * (days_on_policy_in_month / days_in_month). we'll run the Apr/May numbers after you submit.
- If company nexus is triggered in CA, additional employer filings and payroll taxes could apply. we'll escalate to Tax Ops if flagged.
- Shipping/relocation: submit Relocation request for any equipment movement.

Claire (Legal): immigration note — confirm right-to-work in US before any payroll change. if you're dual national or have work authorization, note that on the form; otherwise talk to Legal first.

Tax Ops Bot: New case created: CASE-20260501-MG 12. Assigned: Tax Ops, Nina (Payroll), Sam (People Ops).

Marta G.: if tax ops signs off on no nexus can i still claim SF coworking per-diem for the days i'm in-office?

Sam (People Ops): yes — location-based coworking per-diems can be approved independently of homebase if manager + finance sign off. include requested coworking days in the form.

Marta G.: thanks — i'll submit the forms and attach passport + travel schedule today.

Nina (Payroll): once submitted we'll confirm estimated cutover timeline. if payroll can't flip before your first SF day, we'll advise on temporary payroll workaround (e.g., expense reimbursements or short-term stipend adjustments).

Marta G.: perfect, appreciate it all :heart:
